question.value: How does the outflow affect the formation, destruction, and desorption of molecules, and how does its molecular composition differ from the hot core?

evidence.quote: The goal of the present work is to study the chemistry in the outflow (or in regions impacted by the outflow) and to investigate its role in the formation, destruction, and desorption behaviour of mainly complex but also simpler molecules.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO. ALMA#2016.1.00074.S.
We made use of the data taken as part of the 3 mm imaging spectral-line survey ReMoCA (Re-exploring Molecular Complexity with ALMA).
